description: 15 steps of rockets from paper and gunpowder, which both the special firework_rocket and the data pack's firework_rocket_simple take: every recipe taken with doLimitedCrafting off and on, at a crafting table and in the own window, two gunpowder, the same window again, the simple recipe given and then taken with the rule off; the rockets are made each time and no recipe is added to the book by taking them (the special recipe, first in id order); Circuit and both official servers give identical windows and recipe book packets
